title: Kaddamar, raba kuma ci gaba da sabon fayil ɗinku
course_title: Ginin Fayil na Kan Layi: Nuna Mafi kyawun Ayyukanku da Cin nasara Abokan ciniki

say: Kaddamar, raba, kuma ci gaba da sabunta fayil ɗinku.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo don module huɗu na Ginin Fayilolin Kan layi.
Babban dalilin da ya sa ba a taɓa ƙaddamar da fayil ɗin ba shine cewa aikin yana ɗaukar watanni. Wani ɗan gajeren shiri ya gyara hakan.

say: Fayil ɗin da babu wanda ya buɗe ba zai iya kawo muku aiki ba, don haka hanyar haɗin yanar gizon dole ta tafi inda abokan cinikin ku suke.

panel.heading: Kar a taɓa aika hanyar haɗi mara tushe
left: Hanyar haɗi ba tare da kalmomi ba
right: Wanene kai kuma me yasa kake rubutawa

say: Misali, Amaka ya ba da amsa ga tambayar farashi: ga kek ɗin ranar haihuwar yara na shida, tare da abin da kowane abokin ciniki ya nema. Biredi da aka sawa suna farawa daga kimanin naira 35,000. Wane jigo ne yaranku suke so?
Dalilin danna, abin da za su gani, da mataki na gaba.

panel.heading: Kar a taɓa aika hanyar haɗi mara tushe
left: Hanyar haɗi ba tare da kalmomi ba
right: Wanene kai kuma me yasa kake rubutawa

say: Anan ne bita na kwata-kwata. Grace's tracker yana nuna tambayoyi 18 a cikin watanni uku. 11 ya ambaci fayil ɗin, kuma mafi yawan tambaya game da kayan kwalliyar amarya.

Don haka sai ta musanya sarƙoƙin wuyanta guda biyu mafi rauni na yau da kullun zuwa saitin amarya biyu masu ƙarfi, kuma ta sanya mafi kyawun saitin amarya a gaba. Ta kuma canza kanun labaranta zuwa na amarya da saitin bead.

card.title: Grace tana kiyaye farashinta a halin yanzu

say: Tsohuwar jagorar farashinta ta ce amaryar ta fito daga kimanin naira 18,000.

card.title: Grace tana kiyaye farashinta a halin yanzu

say: Mai siyar da ƙwanƙwasa ta ɗaga farashi, don haka ta sabunta shi zuwa kusan 22,000, kuma ta adana PDF na tsofaffi da sabbin nau'ikan.

card.title: Grace tana kiyaye farashinta a halin yanzu
rows: Sabuwar jagora bayan tashin mai kaya

say: Bayan kowane kyakkyawan aiki, ɗauki hotuna, nemi izini da shaida, kuma rubuta layi uku. Wannan yana ɗaukar mintuna 15 zuwa 20. Wata-wata, bincika tracker da maɓallan ku. Kowane wata uku, karanta shi duka a matsayin baƙo kuma sabunta farashi da hanyoyin haɗin gwiwa.

panel.heading: Sabunta ayyukan yau da kullun
items: Bayan kowane aiki mai kyau: hotuna, izini, layi 3
Wata-wata: duba tracker, musanya yanki mai rauni
Kowane watanni 3: cikakken bita, farashi, hanyoyin haɗin gwiwa
Sabon yanki ya maye gurbin mafi rauni
Ajiye zuwa Google Drive
Tabbatar da matakai biyu a kunne

say: Wani sabon yanki yana shiga ne kawai idan yana da ƙarfi kamar mafi raunin ku, sannan ya maye gurbinsa. Wannan yana kiyaye zaɓin ku.

say: Don tunawa. Gina a cikin kwanaki bakwai, kamar awa ɗaya a rana, kuma a buga lokacin da lissafin ya wuce. Sanya hanyar haɗin yanar gizon ku a duk inda abokan cinikin ku suka duba, kuma koyaushe ku gabatar da shi.
Sabunta kowane wata, kuma kare asusun da ke riƙe fayil ɗin ku.

Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.
